films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries keeps Eurymachus among the leading suitors — smooth speech in the hall before the bow is strung.

popCulture.title: Eurymachus
popCulture.description: Second only to Antinous among the wooers, Eurymachus endures as the eloquent suitor — still first to face Odysseus' arrows after the chief.
